name: Introduction to Freediving
summary: Your first day as a freediver, in the pool. Breathing, relaxation and safe breath-holds with a buddy.

name: Freediver
summary: Your first certification with depth. Pool sessions first, then the Mediterranean on a buoy and line.

name: Advanced Freediver
summary: Deeper open water and more advanced technique, building on what you learned in AIDA 2.

name: Master Freediver
summary: The Master Freediver level, with the deepest training of the four AIDA freediver courses.

name: AIDA Instructor Course
summary: Learn to teach freediving with an AIDA Instructor Trainer. Entry starts with an assessment.
